baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three q-w-l occurrences at words 6, 18, and 24 each launch a restrictive reclassification, while b-y-n frames both the signs and the final accusation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A three-step speech ratchet reduces the event first to a man's intention, then to fabricated falsehood, then to manifest magic. Repetition of the exclusive formula closes inquiry, and the final use of clarity converts the signs' evidentness into evidence for the hostile label.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the three audible acts that progressively lock the event into imposed categories.
Disclosure and manifest appearance bookend the verse, making clarity itself the contested material of classification.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the object that the final label must overwrite.
Arrival makes the truth a present encounter rather than a remote proposition, so the speech is reactive containment.

changed_reading.before: The audience voices three roughly synonymous objections to a message.
changed_reading.after: The audience performs a staged closure operation: agent, message, and effect are successively relabeled until the signs' very clarity is made to certify magic.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins s-d-d at word 13, a-f-k at word 22, k-f-r at word 26, and s-h-r at word 33 around the arriving truth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accusation and the accusers' own labels share one directional mechanism. They warn that the man will turn people away; then inversion, covering, and deceptive redirection turn the arriving truth away from its disclosed face. The charge describes the operation their speech is performing.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies the explicit danger attributed to the man and the directional axis of the model.
Reversing or diverting a thing from its face supplies the first enacted counter-direction against the signs.
Covering supplies the accusers' disposition as an added layer over what has arrived.
Deceptive redirection supplies the final category, mirroring the very diversion charged against the messenger.

changed_reading.before: They identify a prospective act of diversion and then independently call the message false and magical.
changed_reading.after: Their warning is self-revealing: each successive label reenacts the turning and covering that they assign to the messenger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The durative construction at words 15-17 binds established being, submissive worship, and fathers to the threatened diversion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object under defense is not only a belief statement. Continued worship and fatherly formation make an inherited social posture in which obedience, origin, and upbringing reinforce one another. The man is framed as dangerous because he could interrupt transmission.

activation_trace.role: Established occurrence through time supplies the durative continuity attributed to ancestral practice.
Submissive worship supplies the practiced allegiance being protected, not merely an abstract opinion.
Fatherhood and formative nurture make ancestry a transmitting institution as well as a genealogy.
Contested willing toward another's action supplies the social struggle over whose direction the audience will accept.

changed_reading.before: The audience objects because the messenger criticizes an old family religion.
changed_reading.after: The objection protects an inherited formation of obedience and nurture; the messenger threatens the continuity by which allegiance reproduces itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the same social voice points to a man reporting renewed creation and immediately routes the report into fabrication or madness. The focus verse compresses that already available accusation sequence and expands it into a complete label cascade.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people makes the triple utterance function as a reusable public script rather than three private thoughts.
A report delivered to others supplies the earlier message that is attached to a man and made socially suspect.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies one ready-made route for neutralizing that report.
Covering of reason by madness supplies the alternate ready-made route for neutralizing the reporter.

structural_cues: 34:7 names a man who reports renewed creation; 34:8 answers with the paired alternatives of fabrication and madness before 34:43 recombines man, fabrication, and magic.
The same disbelieving speech frame occurs in 34:7 and 34:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the earlier man-report is followed by fabrication-or-madness labels. Reader arrow: the later triple formula reuses and systematizes that sequence as a denial script. Live alternative: the parallels may be separate reactions summarized in similar diction rather than a consciously rehearsed script.

changed_reading.before: The three statements are a local burst of disbelief at one recitation.
changed_reading.after: They are the mature form of a recurring social script that has already learned how to classify both reporter and report out of consideration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence turns chosen withdrawal into requested distance and then into fragmentation. Against that pattern, the focus charge that one man wants to turn people away reads as projection by a culture whose own response to accessible signs is to manufacture distance.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside anchors the accusation whose agency the contextual sequence reopens.
Directional inversion anchors the possibility that the accusation reverses the actual vector of refusal.
Turning one's side away supplies the community's initiating withdrawal from a visible provisioned order.
Actively producing distance supplies the community's explicit preference for separation over accessible connection.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the material outcome of chosen distancing.

structural_cues: 34:16 begins with communal turning away; 34:19 asks that journeys be made distant and ends with the community torn into pieces.
The sequence moves from response, to spatial request, to social consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: turning away, requested distance, and fragmentation occur in sequence. Reader arrow: that history makes the focus accusation a projection of the audience's own distancing habit. Live alternative: the Saba sequence may be an analogy of communal failure without identifying the focus speakers with that community.

changed_reading.before: The audience fears that the messenger will create distance from ancestral worship.
changed_reading.after: Their charge reverses the surah's recurring vector: communities themselves turn from near signs, request distance, and convert connection into fragmentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dialogue holds opposed possibilities in suspension and then assigns separation to a future gathering and opening by truth. The focus speakers instead use restrictive formulas and the word of manifestation to close the case immediately. Their labels are premature verdicts, not findings.

activation_trace.role: Three pronounced judgments supply the immediate closure that contrasts with the preceding procedure.
Manifest disclosure is seized by both sides, so the dispute concerns who may assign what the visible evidence manifests.
Manifest appearance remains attached to one side of an explicitly unresolved guidance-or-error alternative.
Gathering separated parties supplies the forum in which opposed claims can finally meet.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the deferred act that properly separates the claims.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion of that opening rather than a crowd's imposed label.

structural_cues: 34:24 uses a balanced either-us-or-you construction before 34:26 defers separation to gathering and judgment by truth.
34:43 repeats an exclusive formula three times and ends by calling its own verdict manifest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a symmetrical alternative is followed by deferred gathering and truth-based opening. Reader arrow: the exclusive formulas in 34:43 usurp that open procedure with instant closure. Live alternative: 34:24 may be rhetorical challenge rather than a general epistemic method.

changed_reading.before: The speakers offer bad answers to evidence.
changed_reading.after: They seize the office of judgment, closing what the surrounding discourse keeps open until truth itself separates the parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future blame dialogue repeats the focus's exact diversion-and-arrival structure inside a hierarchy of weakened and self-exalting groups. The weaker ask whether the powerful turned them from guidance after it arrived, then identify repeated commands to disbelieve. This relocates active diversion from the isolated man to established social power.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside anchors the disputed agency: the focus crowd assigns this act to the messenger.
Lack of power supplies the dependent social position from which later blame is voiced.
Elevated rank and leadership supply the opposing position capable of shaping communal response.
The same turning-aside action is explicitly put to the powerful as a question of responsibility.
Gentle direction to the true path identifies what social diversion obstructed.
Arrival repeats the focus timing: diversion is disputed only after guidance has become present.
Binding command supplies the concrete mechanism by which dominant voices pressed disbelief on dependents.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 alternates speech between the weakened and the self-exalting, then names command as the mechanism operating by night and day.
34:32 closely repeats turning from guidance after it came, while 34:43 says a man wants to turn the audience away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hierarchy, the repeated diversion-after-arrival clause, and commands to disbelieve are explicit. Reader arrow: the focus warning inoculates the crowd against the messenger by projecting elite direction onto him. Live alternative: 34:32 preserves individual culpability, so social command explains pressure without erasing consent.

changed_reading.before: A crowd independently suspects that one man seeks control over it.
changed_reading.after: Established power preemptively depicts the dissident man as controller while the surrounding dialogue exposes command, hierarchy, and blame as the actual field of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring rejecting voice belongs to affluent town leaders who count wealth and offspring as protection and proximity. This gives the fathers in the focus verse an economic and status-bearing dimension: ancestral worship helps legitimate a lineage whose accumulated goods and descendants appear to certify it.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and formative nurture anchor the lineage whose authority is invoked against change.
Practiced submission anchors the inherited allegiance through which lineage becomes normative.
Expansive luxury supplies the social stratum repeatedly positioned as the first rejecting voice.
Accumulated wealth supplies one visible credential by which that voice declares itself secure.
Offspring and descent supply the reproductive credential that binds status to lineage.
Proximity to favor or rank supplies the status conversion falsely expected from wealth and children.

structural_cues: 34:34 generalizes rejection to affluent leaders; 34:35 names wealth and offspring; 34:37 denies that either produces privileged proximity.
The focus quotation invokes fathers, not merely an unnamed prior doctrine.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: affluent rejecters appeal to wealth and offspring, while the focus appeals to fathers. Reader arrow: ancestral worship also protects a lineage-based status economy. Live alternative: sincere familial attachment can coexist with class interest and should not be reduced to it.

changed_reading.before: The ancestral appeal is conservative affection for inherited custom.
changed_reading.after: It also defends a lineage's social capital, where fathers, offspring, wealth, and presumed proximity mutually validate the inherited order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the supposed recipients of worship disown the relation, redirect allegiance to hidden beings, and the next judgment removes every claimed capacity for benefit or harm. Thus what the fathers worshipped is not a stable, self-verifying relation; it is a transmitted account whose object and efficacy collapse under testimony.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the inherited relation presented in the focus as unquestioned fact.
Paternal transmission anchors why that relation can remain socially certain despite being referentially unstable.
Declaration of freedom from defect supplies the worshipped beings' repudiation of the attributed relation.
Protective allegiance supplies the alternative relation the speakers affirm instead of accepting the worshippers' claim.
Hidden beings supply the redirected object behind the worshippers' misidentified allegiance.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies one claimed efficacy that judgment explicitly removes.
Harm and deficiency supply the other claimed efficacy that judgment explicitly removes.

structural_cues: 34:40 asks the alleged objects whether they were worshipped; 34:41 rejects the attribution and redirects it; 34:42 removes mutual power of benefit and harm.
These verses immediately precede the focus appeal to ancestral worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the worship relation is questioned, disowned, redirected, and stripped of efficacy. Reader arrow: the focus ancestral formula preserves social certainty after referential certainty has failed. Live alternative: the scene concerns ultimate agency and need not deny that the ancestors phenomenologically intended the named objects.

changed_reading.before: The messenger threatens a well-defined worship relation inherited from the fathers.
changed_reading.after: He threatens a socially inherited claim whose supposed recipient, allegiance, and efficacy cannot survive examination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the crowd's triple saying, the discourse breaks the collective into pairs and individuals, requires thought, restores the dismissed man as their companion, tests madness, and removes pecuniary motive. The sequence is an audit procedure for undoing socially amplified labels.

activation_trace.role: Publicly circulating speech anchors the collective label field that the following procedure decomposes.
The generic male person supplies the flattening label that strips away the audience's lived relation to the speaker.
Joining one to one supplies the smallest social unit retained for checking the crowd's judgment.
The solitary individual supplies the point at which inherited and collective pressure can be tested alone.
The heart's repeated movement through a matter supplies deliberation in place of restrictive naming.
Companionship and sustained proximity restore known relational evidence erased by the generic 'man' label.
Covering of reason supplies the accusation that the prescribed reflection is asked to test directly.
Payment for work supplies the motive test that removes a simple material explanation for the warning.

structural_cues: 34:46 moves from standing, to pairs, to individuals, to reflection, then names 'your companion' and rejects madness.
34:47 immediately audits compensation, while 34:43 had inferred intention without inquiry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the post-focus imperatives reduce group scale and test relation, mental state, and payment. Reader arrow: this is an epistemic decontamination procedure aimed at the crowd-generated labels in 34:43. Live alternative: paired reflection remains social and may support rather than merely escape collective judgment.

changed_reading.before: The focus records objections that should be answered proposition by proposition.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a scale-dependent labeling process; the next verses answer by shrinking the crowd, restoring acquaintance, and auditing mind and motive.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus says truth came to them, truth is cast and arrives again, revelation is heard from one who is near, and the rejecters later cast speech from afar, cannot reach from that distance, and meet a barrier. The focus becomes the hinge where present proximity is converted into terminal distance by counter-casting labels.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood anchors what is presently available before the spatial reversal.
Arrival anchors the initial proximity: truth has already reached the speakers when they label it.
Forceful casting supplies the forward motion by which truth is projected into the field.
The same fixed truth identifies what completes the repeated arrival formula after the focus.
Repeated arrival confirms that the issue is response to presence, not lack of access.
Nearness supplies the stated relation of the revealer to the hearing subject before final separation.
Reaching by extension supplies the later attempt to obtain belief after the moment of access has passed.
Distance opposed to nearness makes that attempt structurally impossible.
Throwing speech or fault supplies the rejecters' counter-casting toward the unseen from a remote position.
A separating barrier supplies the terminal stabilization of the distance earlier produced in speech.

structural_cues: 34:48-50 moves through casting truth, truth's arrival, revelation, hearing, and nearness.
34:51-54 moves through near capture, failed reaching from afar, remote verbal casting, and a final barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: presence and nearness precede failed remote reaching and separation. Reader arrow: the labels in 34:43 are the hinge that converts offered proximity into lived distance. Live alternative: the final barrier may be imposed judgment rather than a direct psychological product of the earlier speech, so the causal link remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: The speakers reject truth at the moment it arrives, and later judgment happens separately.
changed_reading.after: Their counter-casting at the moment of arrival initiates a spatial trajectory: what was near becomes something they can only reach for, and speak about, from too far away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two distinct roots and treats recitation's sequencing as a social image, not as an etymological identity. It remains anchored in the focus's t-l-w recitation and fathers, and in the explicit following of conjecture at 34:20. Downstream prose should present it as a structural wordplay about succession, not translate recitation as allegiance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recited sequence at word 2 enters a verse whose explicit fear is departure from a paternal chain of worship.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another supplies recitation as an ordered chain entering the hearing community.
Paternal formation supplies the rival inherited chain whose continuity the crowd protects.
Uncertain conjecture supplies the content that nevertheless becomes behaviorally effective.
Following in another's track supplies the enacted allegiance that contrasts with merely hearing the recited chain.

changed_reading.before: Recitation delivers information that threatens an inherited doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Recitation introduces a rival succession: ordered words arrive where paternal formation and the following of conjecture already compete to determine whose track continues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant t-l-l mapping for the focus root; it must not be offered as the lexical translation of the passive recitation verb. It remains worth carrying because the focus anchors it at the recitation event and 34:14 couples collapse with disclosure. Downstream prose should qualify it strictly as a material analogy for the recitation's effect on inherited supports.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive recitation at word 2 initiates the encounter, and the verse immediately voices fear that an established inherited practice will be displaced.

activation_trace.role: Agitation and destabilizing movement from the split mapping supplies an exploratory image for what the recitation does to a settled structure.
Noisy, disturbed collapse supplies the material event by which a falsely supported order visibly fails.
Disclosure following collapse supplies the sequence in which destabilization reveals what prior stability concealed.

changed_reading.before: Recitation is a neutral delivery followed by defensive speech.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, recitation is the disturbance under which inherited supports begin to shake, making defensive labels a response to threatened structural collapse.

strongest_changes: The triple exclusive formula is a label-based closure mechanism that flips the signs' clarity into supposed proof of magic.
The social dialogue at 34:31-33 reverses the alleged agency of diversion, locating command and pressure in established hierarchy.
The post-focus move to pairs, individuals, reflection, companionship, and motive testing functions as an audit of crowd-generated labels.
The ending turns truth's arrival and nearness into failed reaching from afar, making 34:43 the hinge of a proximity-to-distance trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence exposed 34:43 as a hinge rather than an isolated polemic: earlier accusations supply a reusable script, historical communities embody chosen distance, power disputes who diverted whom, and the following verses deliberately dismantle the focus's collective verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The projection model is strongly patterned but does not prove that the focus speakers consciously know they are reversing their own act.
The status-economy reading should remain alongside, not replace, sincere attachment to familial tradition.
The rival-following and destabilization outliers are analogical activations; the non-dominant split mapping especially must not control translation.
